B025-G03: Entire reduced on a continuation, consisting of three marks. The preceding alors remains outside.
B025-G04: Complete large operator, high transverse run, upper-left curved return, doubled bowl and alpha-in-K limit, each once.
B025-S02: Complete hatted Sigma with joined head, alpha, plus, and the two small traces between plus and alpha. No separate copy of either mark.
B025-G05: Whole terminal deleted cluster and its crossing, with no added comma.
B025-G06: Complete bowl, inner angular form and descending return before les; les remains outside.
B025-S04: Complete disjointness Sigma, separate upper head run, alpha and plus; recurring head-role qualification is first printed in S01.
B025-S05: Complete prose Sigma with detached upper head, alpha and plus; parenthetical condition remains outside.
B025-S06: Complete signed plus Sigma, detached head, plus and one short index stroke; i/prime and head-role doubts recur from S01.
B025-S07: Complete signed minus Sigma, detached head, minus and single short index; sentence full stop remains outside.
B025-M01: Faint upper curve, pale middle continuation, lower diagonal/foot and detached left foot run.
B025-M02: Both isolated lower-right points, with no colon or other character supplied.
B025-G09: Complete final que, its long q descender, and one separate small point at its right. Je dis remains outside; no additional que or point is printed.
